description: (K)₂NaNdCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaNdCl₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaNdCl₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Nd is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NdCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nd-Cl bond lengths are 2.72 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Nd atom.
